units.source_text: 有为子独自攀登石灰石的一百零五级台阶去了。

en.t: Uiko climbed the one hundred and five limestone steps alone.
Like a madwoman, her heart filled with proud emotion...

units.source_text: 在她的黑西服和黑头发之间，惟有她那美丽的侧脸是洁白的。

en.t: Between her black suit and her black hair, only her beautiful profile was white.
